description: This file is a script for seeding user data into a MongoDB database for the freeCodeCamp project, including handling command-line arguments, connecting to MongoDB, and inserting predefined user data.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles errors during database operations, logs error messages, closes the database client, and exits the process.

methods.name: dropUserTokens
methods.description: Deletes user token documents for specified user IDs from the database.

methods.name: dropUsers
methods.description: Deletes user documents for specified user IDs from the database.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main async function that connects to the database, clears existing user data, inserts new user data based on command-line arguments, and closes the connection.
